doc.md:
Renders a keyboard accelerator in a cell

`GtkCellRendererAccel` displays a keyboard accelerator (i.e. a key
combination like `Control + a`). If the cell renderer is editable,
the accelerator can be changed by simply typing the new combination.

accel-mode.brief: Determines if the edited accelerators are GTK accelerators.
accel-mode.md:
Determines if the edited accelerators are GTK accelerators. If
they are, consumed modifiers are suppressed, only accelerators
accepted by GTK are allowed, and the accelerators are rendered
in the same way as they are in menus.

accel-mods.brief: The modifier mask of the accelerator.
accel-mods.md: The modifier mask of the accelerator.

keycode.brief: The hardware keycode of the accelerator.
keycode.md:
The hardware keycode of the accelerator. Note that the hardware keycode is
only relevant if the key does not have a keyval. Normally, the keyboard
configuration should assign keyvals to all keys.

accel-cleared.brief: Gets emitted when the user has removed the accelerator.
accel-cleared.md: Gets emitted when the user has removed the accelerator.

accel-edited.brief: Gets emitted when the user has selected a new accelerator.
accel-edited.md: Gets emitted when the user has selected a new accelerator.
